title: Field monitor stops reporting false GitHub alerts
summary: For the site owner: the Field monitor no longer warns "GitHub workflows could not be checked" when a refresh reuses a recent reading, and the weekly development speed summary retries GitHub's brief server errors instead of failing for the week.
items: When GitHub is slow during a refresh, the monitor reuses its last validated reading (up to 35 minutes old) and now says so, with the reading's time, instead of reporting a warning.
Readings older than that, and readings that were never validated, are still reported as gaps.
The weekly development speed summary repeats a GitHub read up to four times after a rate limit, server error or dropped connection. Writes are never repeated.
